learning_objective: 🎯 Let's unroll the scrolls of time to explore the Vedas, ancient wisdom, and how early Indians lived, thought, and prayed!

main_concepts.concept_title: 📚 The Books of Knowledge: The Vedas
main_concepts.simple_explanation: The word Veda means knowledge. The Vedas are some of the oldest books in the world, filled with beautiful poems and prayers. The oldest one is called the Rigveda!
Before paper and pens were invented, students learned the Vedas just by listening to their teachers and memorizing every single word perfectly. This is called the oral tradition.
The early Vedic people loved and respected nature. They sang hymns to powerful nature gods like Agni (fire), Indra (rain and thunder), and Surya (the sun) to keep them happy and safe.

fun_activity.title: 🗣️ The Memory Game
fun_activity.instructions: Ask a friend or parent to say a long sentence or a short poem. Try to repeat it back to them perfectly without looking at any paper, just like the students of the Vedic age!

quick_recap: ⭐ The Vedas are ancient Indian texts containing profound knowledge and beautiful hymns.
⭐ The Rigveda is the oldest Veda, composed in ancient Sanskrit.
⭐ Early Indians memorized texts by listening and worshipped elements of nature.
